basic_info.description: Welcome to 378 Los Palmos, a well-maintained home in the heart of Miraloma Park. From the moment you step inside, warm wood floors and natural light create an inviting atmosphere. The main level features a functional layout with two bedrooms, one bathroom, and a combined living and dining area with a cozy fireplace. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a peaceful backyard perfect for relaxing or entertaining. This home also features paid solar, air conditioning, and EV charger in the one-car garage that offers potential to create a bonus space or an additional bedroom. Nestled in a charming, quiet, and convenient location offering easy access to highways 280 and 101, as well as MUNI makes commuting is a breeze.
